kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Classical Syriac ܫܒܛ (šḇāṭ), ultimately from Akkadian 𒌚𒀾 (Šabāṭum). Cognate with Hebrew שְׁבָט (sh'vat, “Shebat, the eleventh month of the Hebrew lunisolar calendar”).
s: Hebrew שְׁבָט (sh'vat, “Shebat, the eleventh month of the Hebrew lunisolar calendar”)
g: February, the 2nd month of the Gregorian calendar

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowing from Aramaic שִׁבּוּטָא (šebbūṭā), ܫܰܒܽܘܛܳܐ (šabbūṭā), from שְׁבַט (šḇaṭ), ܫܰܒܶܛ (šabeṭ, “to beat out; to straighten”).
g: carp (any fish of the genus Cyprinus)

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Singulative noun composed of شَبُّوط (šabbūṭ, “carp”) + ـَة (-a).
g: carp (any fish of the genus Cyprinus)
